title: Prismatic Grain
description: Un style d'illustration numérique doux et onirique, caractérisé par un bruit pointillé dense et uniforme et des dégradés de couleurs vibrants et irisés. Les sujets sont rendus sans contours nets, s'appuyant sur des teintes changeantes et un éclairage lumineux et dispersé pour définir le volume et la forme.
description_en: A soft, dreamlike digital illustration style characterized by heavy, uniform stippled noise and vibrant, iridescent color gradients. Subjects are rendered without harsh outlines, relying on shifting hues and luminous, dispersed lighting to define volume and form.
description_fr: Un style d'illustration numérique doux et onirique, caractérisé par un bruit pointillé dense et uniforme et des dégradés de couleurs vibrants et irisés. Les sujets sont rendus sans contours nets, s'appuyant sur des teintes changeantes et un éclairage lumineux et dispersé pour définir le volume et la forme.
prompt: Soft, dreamlike digital illustration utilizing heavy, uniform stippled noise and vibrant, iridescent color gradients. Apply this style to the complete scene described by {{subject}}, preserving its factual content, camera angle, framing, spatial layout, and stated exclusions. The image must occupy the absolute entire dedicated space, full bleed to all four corners with no borders or frames. Render forms without harsh outlines or distinct linework; instead, define volume and spatial relationships through shifting hues and luminous, dispersed lighting. Color palettes should feature smooth transitions between {{primary_color}}, {{accent_color}}, and {{secondary_color}}, creating a prismatic, glowing effect. Lighting acts as a diffuse, atmospheric wash, creating soft gradients that blend seamlessly into shadows, avoiding stark contrast or specular highlights. The texture is dominated by a pervasive, fine, sand-like grain or stipple effect that unifies the composition, giving it a tactile, risograph-like quality. Edges are soft and slightly feathered, blending gently into adjacent color fields. Depth is achieved through overlapping shapes and atmospheric perspective driven by color temperature shifts rather than strict linear perspective. video.motion: Elements should drift slowly and fluidly, with color gradients shifting and pulsating gently across surfaces. Avoid fast or jerky movements; maintain a calm, ethereal pacing.
video.camera: Slow, smooth pans or subtle zooms that emphasize the shifting light and color fields.
video.temporal_texture: The heavy stippled noise must remain consistent and act as a static overlay or gently undulating grain, avoiding distracting flicker, while color gradients transition smoothly.
video.avoid: Sharp, sudden movements, high-contrast lighting shifts, hard edges, and clean, untextured surfaces.
